gizmo.title: Ecosystem web
gizmo.description: An interactive web of how the parts of a project connect, with sub-webs and step-by-step tours.

configure.title: Web data
configure.description: URL of the JSON bundle of webs (built in PRAW, ecosystem-webs.json).

configure.title: Web
configure.description: Id of the web to show first; main is the ecosystem web.

configure.title: Selected tile
configure.description: Id of a tile to select when the web opens.

configure.title: Tour
configure.description: Id of a tour to start on.

configure.title: Start in list view
configure.description: Show the web as nested lists instead of the drawing.

configure.title: Drawing only
configure.description: Show just the drawing, as a figure: no header, tours, details or step bar.

advanced.title: Read by
advanced.description: Start with every tile read by one measure.
